observed_structure: contiguous_scan parameterizes the element types, source operator, values per thread, inclusive or exclusive output mode, and forward or reverse traversal, then keeps a thread-local prefix alongside a threadgroup SIMDgroup-summary array.
For each contiguous axis block, each thread selects a full or tail load, forms a serial prefix over its register values, and applies the operator's SIMDgroup-exclusive scan to its terminal value.

A barrier precedes last-lane publication of each SIMDgroup summary, a second barrier precedes SIMDgroup zero's exclusive scan of those summaries, and a third barrier precedes use of the resulting per-SIMDgroup prefix.
Each register value is updated from the carried block prefix, the per-SIMDgroup prefix, and the per-thread prefix before an inclusive or exclusive forward or reverse output branch writes it.

At the end of each axis block, a barrier precedes publication of the terminal value by the last lane of the last active SIMDgroup into slot zero, a second barrier precedes all threads reading that slot into the thread-local prefix, and the next block iteration consumes that carried value.
variant_notes: This observation covers contiguous_scan only; the collected kernel family also instantiates a distinct strided_scan path selected by host stride metadata.

Operator kind, dtype, values per thread, inclusive or exclusive output, forward or reverse traversal, tail branches, and their numerical ordering remain implementation parameters rather than normalized semantics.
Safe and unsafe helper names and barrier placement do not establish bounds, zero fill, visibility sufficiency, uniform participation, race or deadlock freedom, or memory safety.
The last-lane summary publication and first-SIMDgroup exclusive prefix scan do not satisfy the existing lane-zero partial plus second-reduction candidate and do not widen its frozen Stage 3 closure.
